Pfizer’s CISO organization delivers proactive cyber defense for Pfizer global enterprise. Our mission is to secure all of Pfizer’s digital information assets ranging from our scientific breakthroughs to the manufacturing floor, and out to the patients we serve. We achieve this mission through a combination of world-class talent, top-tier technologies, industry leading best practices, and the promotion of a cybersecurity ownership culture across the company. We are seeking an experienced Senior Manager, Business Integration and Application Onboarding to serve as a strategic partner between ISAM and application owners, guiding teams through the adoption of ISAM solutions such as SailPoint, CyberArk, and other identity security technologies. What You Will Achieve The Senior Manager, Business Integration and Application Onboarding is a key role within the Identity Security and Access Management (ISAM) organization, responsible for driving successful onboarding, integration, and adoption of applications across enterprise identity platforms, including SailPoint, CyberArk, and other IAM technologies. This role serves as the strategic bridge between the ISAM Engineering team and business technology organizations, partnering with application owners, Digital teams, and key stakeholders to translate business needs into secure, scalable identity solutions. The Senior Manager will lead the end-to-end application onboarding lifecycle, ensuring integrations align with security standards, architectural principles, and operational requirements while driving adoption of ISAM capabilities, delivering a seamless customer experience, and advancing Pfizer’s identity security objectives. This role reports to the Director, Identity Governance, and requires a combination of IAM expertise, technical understanding, stakeholder management, and delivery leadership to drive adoption of ISAM capabilities and continuously improve the onboarding experience for application teams. How You Will Achieve It Lead and oversee the end-to-end application onboarding lifecycle for identity and access management platforms, including application discovery, requirements gathering, integration planning, implementation, testing, deployment, and transition to operational support in alignment with Pfizer’s compliance requirements. Serve as the primary relationship owner between the ISAM Engineering team and application owners across Digital organizations, ensuring alignment between business needs, security requirements, technical capabilities, and delivery expectations. Partner with application teams to understand application architectures, identity data requirements, and business processes to define appropriate IAM integration approaches and enable secure access management solutions. Drive adoption of IAM capabilities, including identity lifecycle management, access governance, privileged access management, authentication and directory services, ensuring applications leverage ISAM capabilities effectively. Manage application onboarding roadmaps, priorities, dependencies, risks, and delivery milestones across multiple concurrent initiatives to ensure successful execution and stakeholder alignment. Establish and maintain standardized onboarding processes, documentation, governance practices, and communication models to improve scalability, consistency, and customer experience. Identify opportunities to improve onboarding efficiency through automation, process optimization, and platform enhancements. Define and track key performance indicators related to application onboarding, adoption, delivery timelines, operational effectiveness, and continuous improvement. jobs.description: Our mission is to provide immediate, personalized clinical support—whether it’s a moment of crisis, clinical consultation, or a step towards lasting change. jobs.description: Amazon Robotics is seeking a Senior Embedded Software Engineer with deep Rust expertise to help lead development of safety-rated sensor processing firmware for one of the world's largest autonomous robot fleets. You will set technical direction for major subsystems of the Safety Perception stack (real-time safety applications, sensor processing pipelines, and system interfaces on heterogeneous multi-core MCU/CPU/GPU platforms) that let robots in Amazon facilities worldwide detect and respond to obstacles safely and reliably. You will own the team's hardest end-to-end problems, framing solutions where the business need is clear but the technical strategy is not, and raise the bar for the engineers around you. We are looking for a technical leader who is deeply proficient in Rust (or strong in C/C++ and eager to work in Rust), is fluent across the boundary between RTOS and Linux on the same chip, has substantial experience with sensor data acquisition or signal processing, and can architect systems that meet the rigor of IEC 61508 functional safety certification. You will influence beyond your immediate team, shaping designs, resolving escalations, mitigating long-term one-way-door risks, and mentoring engineers, all while collaborating closely with hardware, functional safety, and navigation teams to deliver firmware where correctness is not optional. Key job responsibilities The ideal candidate is a force multiplier who sets technical direction across teams and raises the bar for associate safety. They will: - Lead the design and architecture of major safety-rated and non-safety-rated firmware subsystems in Rust on heterogeneous multi-core platforms, where real-time safety code and Linux services coexist on the same chip. - Set technical direction across the full sensor processing pipeline (driver integration, frame acquisition, point cloud generation, collision detection) and influence peer hardware, safety, and navigation teams. - Own the team's hardest end-to-end problems, framing solutions where the business problem is known but the technical strategy is not. - Drive perception features that let robots detect and respond to obstacles under IEC 61508 certification, ensuring data integrity through black-channel diagnostics. - Raise the technical bar through design and code reviews, and mentor engineers so the team is more reliable because of your presence but does not require it. - Produce direction-setting design documents and safety analysis artifacts that meet the rigor of third-party certification and witness testing. - Lead debugging and root-cause analysis end-to-end, from raw sensor data to safety responses, on real robots at test facilities and in production. - Leverage AI coding assistants as a force multiplier and lead the team to do the same. A day in the life No two days are the same. You might spend the morning aligning peer teams around a subsystem architecture in a design review, then head to the test floor after lunch to lead a cross-functional debug with electrical and QA engineers, determining whether an issue is firmware, hardware, or a faulty sensor. That afternoon you profile a pipeline to close a latency budget, then pair with another engineer to unblock their design. Our engineers take complete ownership (from interrupt handlers to CI/CD pipelines to on-site data collection) and frequently enter new areas to meet our customers' needs. As a senior engineer, you help chart where the team goes next. About the team The Safety Perception team is a group of passionate embedded software engineers who apply advances in robotics and sensor processing to real-world safety challenges. We write embedded Rust on platforms where correctness is not optional, and we own the full stack: from low-level driver integration to system APIs to the test infrastructure that proves our firmware works. We take our responsibility for safety seriously while challenging ourselves to ship the right product at the performance we need. We pay attention to the details so others do not have to, making systems intuitive enough that safety does not need a second thought.

쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.

쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 유지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.

쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.

조직 소개

쿠팡이츠(Coupang Eats)는 음식배달을 시작으로 장보기와 쇼핑까지 서비스 영역을 확장하며 고객의 일상을 더욱 편리하게 만드는 새로운 경험을 만들어가고 있습니다. 고객에게 더 나은 경험을 제공하기 위한 끊임없는 고민을 바탕으로 도전하며, 새로운 서비스와 카테고리의 변화를 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡이츠는 스스로 기회를 만들고 결과를 만들어낸 구성원에게 더 큰 역할과 책임을 부여하고 있습니다. 자신의 아이디어를 실행으로 옮기고, 성과를 통해 더 큰 기회를 만들어가며, 비즈니스의 성장을 직접 이끄는 성취감을 경험할 수 있습니다.

퀵커머스팀은 퀵커머스 비즈니스를 개발, 데이터, 오퍼레이션, 프로덕트, MD, 물류 등 다양한 기능과 연결하여 성장시키는 역할을 담당합니다. 정량적 분석을 통해 비즈니스의 핵심 문제와 성장 기회를 발굴하고, 분석 결과를 명확한 우선순위, 가설, 실험 및 실행 과제로 전환합니다. 이츠의 퀵커머스는 다양한 조직과의 긴밀한 협업이 필수적인 만큼, 데이터를 기반으로 유관 조직을 정렬하고 복잡한 문제를 구조화하여 의사결정을 이끌어냅니다. 유통 및 물류 산업에 대한 높은 이해도를 바탕으로 SQL과 AI를 적극 활용하여 문제를 해결하고, 빠르게 변화하는 환경에서 높은 오너십으로 과제를 끝까지 추진할 수 있는 인재를 찾습니다.

업무 내용

• 퀵커머스 신사업의 전반적인 비즈니스 분석을 주도합니다: 핵심 성과의 Gap과 성장 기회를 발굴하고, 영향도를 정량화하여 실행 가능한 우선순위와 과제로 전환합니다.
• SQL 및 데이터 분석 도구를 활용해 복잡한 사업·운영 문제의 원인을 분석하고, 데이터 기반 가설을 수립하며, 해결책을 검증하기 위한 실험을 설계하고 성과를 분석합니다.
• Product, Operations, MD, Logistics 등 다양한 유관 조직과 긴밀하게 협업하여 개선 과제를 정의하고, 데이터와 논리를 기반으로 이해관계자를 정렬하며, 문제 정의부터 실행 및 론칭까지 과제를 주도합니다.
• 비즈니스 성과와 운영 효율을 지속적으로 개선할 수 있도록 반복 가능한 운영 체계, 대시보드 및 의사결정 Framework를 구축하고, 성과를 지속적으로 측정하며 개선 사이클을 운영합니다.

자격 요건

• 경영, 경제, 통계, 공학, 컴퓨터과학 또는 유관 분야의 학사 학위 이상 또는 이에 준하는 실무 경험을 보유하신 분
• SQL을 통한 데이터분석이 가능하며 대규모 비즈니스운영 데이터를 직접 분석하고 그 결과를 실제 비즈니스 의사결정으로 연결한 경험이 있으신 분
• 모호하고 복잡한 문제를 구조화하고 근본 원인을 도출하며, 데이터 기반 가설을 수립하고 측정 가능한 성과까지 실행을 주도한 경험이 있으신 분
• 유통, 이커머스, Q-Commerce, O2O 또는 플랫폼 비즈니스 관련 분야에서 8년 이상의 실무 경험을 보유하신 분
• MD, 재고, Fulfillment, 물류, 가격, 구매 또는 매장 운영 등 유통 전반의 업무에 대한 높은 이해도를 보유하신 분
• 다양한 유관 부서와 데이터, 명확한 논리 및 구조화된 문제 해결 방식을 바탕으로 커뮤니케이션하고 합의를 이끌어낸 경험이 있으신 분
• 빠르게 변화하는 환경에서 높은 오너십을 바탕으로 스스로 문제의 우선순위를 정하고, 조직 간 경계를 넘어 해결책을 실행까지 추진할 수 있으신 분

우대 사항

• 이커머스 또는 Q-Commerce 비즈니스에 대한 높은 이해도를 보유하고, 상품·재고·가격·구매·Fulfillment·물류·매장 운영 등 유통 전반의 구조와 주요 지표를 사업 성과 관점에서 이해하실 수 있는 분
• 리테일·이커머스 환경에서 BizOps, Strategy & Operations, Product Operations, Business Analytics 또는 유사한 역할을 수행한 경험이 있으신 분
• 사업 또는 프로젝트의 초기 기획 단계부터 문제 정의, 프로세스 설계, 이해관계자 조율, 개발·실행, 론칭 및 운영 안정화까지 A-Z 전 과정을 직접 주도한 경험이 있으신 분

전형 절차 및 안내 사항

• 전형절차

• 전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.

• 참고사항

• 본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.
• 지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.
• 취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.

• 채용 및 업무 수행과 관련하여 요구되는 법령상 자격이 갖추어지지 않은 경우 채용이 제한될 수 있습니다.
• 고용형태는 정규직으로 수습기간 12주를 포함합니다. 단, 업무상 필요한 경우에는 상기 수습기간을 적용하지 않거나 단축 또는 연장할 수 있습니다.

개인정보 처리방침

• 쿠팡 그룹은 입사지원자 개인정보 처리방침(아래 링크)에 따라 귀하의 개인정보를 수집하여 처리합니다. https://www.coupang.jobs/kr/privacy-policy/

서류 반환 정책

• 본 고지는 『채용절차의공정화에관한법률』 제11조제6항에 따른 것 입니다.

• 당사는 위2항 본문에 따른 구직자의 반환 청구에 대비하여 채용 여부가 확정된 날로부터 180 일간 구직자가 제출한 채용서류 원본을 보관하게 되며, 그때까지 채용서류의 반환을 청구하지 아니할 경우에는 『개인정보 보호법』에 따라 지체 없이 채용서류 일체를 파기할 예정입니다.
• 단, 위 1항 내지 4항의 내용은 대한민국의 노동 관계 법령이 적용되는 경우에만 적용됩니다. 그 이외의 경우에는 적용되지 않습니다.

At U.S. Bank, we’re on a journey to do our best. Helping the customers and businesses we serve to make better and smarter financial decisions and enabling the communities we support to grow and succeed. We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bank gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive at every stage of your career. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One.

Job Description

The Estate Settlement Officer assumes primary responsibility for administering post-death settlement accounts when U.S. Bank serves in a fiduciary capacity. This role manages settlement activities in a manner that meets client needs and expectations, supports timely and effective administration, and ensures compliance with applicable legal requirements, fiduciary standards, business line policies, and internal procedures. The Estate Settlement Officer also assists with prospective and existing client opportunities involving potential post-death settlement matters, reviews matters for acceptance or refusal of a fiduciary role and serves as a subject matter resource for colleagues on post-death settlement issues.

Reviews and interprets trust agreements, wills and other estate planning documents where the bank is acting as trustee, executor, administrator, conservator, guardian, depositor, or agent. Coordinates information between clients, external attorneys and internal specialists to ensure accurate, timely and efficient estate settlement. Administers accounts in a manner that ensures compliance with legal requirements and business line policies and procedures.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

-Administers post-death settlement matters. Administers probate estates, post-death trusts, and other post-death fiduciary relationships to carry out the decedent’s objectives, comply with governing documents, uphold fiduciary administration principles, and serve the best interests of beneficiaries.

-Plans and coordinates settlement activities. Identifies actions required to administer and complete the settlement process, assigns responsibilities to appropriate internal and external resources, and monitors progress through completion.

-Resolves fiduciary and compliance matters. Recognizes and resolves trust, tax, banking, investment, and compliance issues under relevant laws and fiduciary responsibilities.

-Maintains beneficiary and family relationships. Meets with family members and beneficiaries on a regular basis to provide information, address questions, and support effective administration.

-Manages estate assets. Arranges for the collection, valuation, retention, liquidation, transfer, or distribution of estate and trust assets, as appropriate.

-Coordinates specialty asset administration. Coordinates the valuation, management, liquidation, or transfer of complex and specialty assets in partnership with internal and external subject matter experts.

-Coordinates tax-related activity. Coordinates the preparation of federal and state tax filings in collaboration with internal tax experts and external professionals.

-Identifies and mitigates risk. Identifies fiduciary, operational, legal, tax, and reputational risks and implements appropriate mitigation strategies throughout the settlement process.

-Manages external relationships. Manages relationships with beneficiaries, family members, attorneys, advisors, accountants, court personnel, and other interested parties in coordination with our internal relationship team to facilitate effective administration and resolution of post-death settlement matters.

-Provides client-focused service. Delivers a high level of service to external parties involved in post-death settlement administration.

-Maintains regulatory and policy compliance. Ensures compliance with the U.S. Bank Code of Ethics and all applicable Anti-Money Laundering, Bank Secrecy Act, information security, suspicious activity reporting, account opening, corporate training, and business line requirements, policies, and procedures.

Basic Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree, or equivalent work experience
- Eight or more years of personal trust and/or estate planning experience

Founded in 2013, Voodoo is a tech company that creates mobile games and apps with a mission to entertain the world. Our portfolio includes chart-topping games like Mob Control and Block Jam, alongside popular apps such as BeReal and Wizz.

TEAM

The Engineering & Data team builds innovative tech products and platforms to support the impressive growth of their gaming and consumer apps which allow Voodoo to stay at the forefront of the mobile industry.

Helix is our flagship Ad-Network team of around 60 top-tier engineers and data scientists spanning backend, mobile SDKs, data engineering, infrastructure, and AI. Helix has evolved beyond powering Voodoo's own gaming portfolio—our technology is now directly integrated into games from external, third-party publishers worldwide.

Operating across millions of third-party devices in real-time bidding environments creates unique technical challenges around SDK performance, ultra-low latency, and intelligent automation.

Within Helix, you’ll join the AdExperience squad—a focused team of Senior Product Managers, QA/Release Engineers, and five exceptional Senior Engineers specialized in backend and mobile SDK development. Together, you will push the boundaries of iOS SDK architecture and champion modern, agentic AI workflows to set new industry standards.

ROLE

We’re looking for a visionary and talented Senior iOS Engineer to join our dynamic, passionate, and committed to excellence team at the forefront of advertising technology!

As a Senior iOS Engineer, you will drive the development of cutting-edge SDKs, influencing the experience of millions of users across diverse devices. A pivotal member of our engineering team, you will help shape the direction of our iOS technical efforts while serving as a high-impact, hands-on individual contributor.

- Technical Vision & Code Standards: Guide the technical direction for our iOS projects. Drive innovation, establish architectural best practices, and ensure the highest standards of code craftsmanship across our codebase.

- AI Usage & Agentic Workflows: Raise the bar in AI adoption across the team—actively integrating agentic workflows, LLMs, and AI-driven automation tools to solve complex challenges and elevate developer productivity.

- Code Excellence: Craft robust, maintainable, and high-performance code that sets industry benchmarks as a senior hands-on individual contributor.

- Collaborative Code Reviews: Actively participate in thorough code reviews, fostering a culture of continuous technical improvement and knowledge sharing within the engineering team.

- Architectural Decisions: Make critical decisions regarding the architecture and technical stack of our iOS SDKs and applications to ensure long-term stability and scalability.

- Quality Assurance: Guarantee the enduring quality and reliability of our iOS projects through rigorous testing, performance profiling, and continuous integration practices.

PROFILE

- 6/7+ years of experience in mobile software development.

- 5 years minimum in Swift.

- Strong proficiency and proactive mindset towards leveraging AI technologies (e.g., agentic AI, LLMs, AI coding assistants) to enhance software development efficiency and code quality.

- Excellent problem-solving, critical thinking, and communication skills.

- Demonstrated ability to make critical technical decisions independently.

- Extensive experience in writing robust, maintainable, and high-performance Swift code.

- Writing efficient unit tests, integration tests, and UI tests.

- In-depth knowledge of iOS development tools, frameworks (SwiftUI, Combine, and CoreData), and best practices (MVVM, Protocols, Delegates).

- Excellent level of spoken English.

NICE TO HAVE

- Previous experience in the AdTech industry or in mobile ads integration.

- Experience with SDK development and a deep understanding of the challenges and opportunities in this space.

- Experience in Objective-C, Kotlin, Node.

- Practical experience setting up or customizing AI developer agents and automated AI workflows.

- Experience in optimizing App performance, reducing memory footprint, and decreasing package size.

- Experience in deploying iOS frameworks on CocoaPods.

- Experience in deploying iOS applications with CircleCI and Fastlane.

- Working knowledge of remote APIs, concurrency, layouts, transitions, animations.

OUR STACK

⧫ Xcode ⧫ Swift ⧫ Objective-C ⧫ SwiftUI ⧫ Combine ⧫ CoreData ⧫ GitHub ⧫ CocoaPods ⧫ CircleCI ⧫ AWS ⧫ AI Coding Tools & Agentic Workflows

BENEFITS
